evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal SG-3 explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking, and the hazard describes the corresponding hazardous event as the vehicle suddenly stopping without an obstacle in front.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: Braking behavior of the ego vehicle in the stated driving situation, specifically whether braking occurs as intended or unintentionally.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, with good weather and no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazardous event defines the relevant operational situation and characterizes the concern as an unexpected stop in that situation.

distinctions.contrast_a: The vehicle brakes as intended to avoid an obstacle or for another justified braking purpose within the operational situation.
distinctions.contrast_b: The vehicle brakes without an obstacle in front, i.e. an unintended braking event occurs.
distinctions.rationale: Collapsing intended and unintended braking would remove the ability to evaluate whether the safety goal is satisfied, because the concern is specifically about distinguishing normal braking from the hazardous event.

distinctions.dimension: Presence of obstacle ahead in the driving path
distinctions.contrast_a: An obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the relevant trajectory.
distinctions.contrast_b: No obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle.
distinctions.rationale: The hazard and FR-7 indicate braking is expected in response to obstacles; without preserving whether an obstacle is present, one cannot distinguish justified braking from unintended braking.

distinctions.dimension: Failure status relevant to braking control chain
distinctions.contrast_a: A controller failure or brake actuator failure is present.
distinctions.contrast_b: No controller failure or brake actuator failure is present.
distinctions.rationale: The requirements explicitly require identification and mitigation of controller failures and brake actuator failures, which are relevant because such failures may lead to unintended braking or loss of control.

orrs.obligation: An admissible observable representation shall preserve whether braking events are intended/justified versus unintended in the monitored operational situation.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must allow intended braking and unintended braking to be told apart as different cases; they must not be collapsed into a single braking outcome.

orrs.obligation: An admissible observable representation shall preserve whether an obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle in the relevant driving path.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish obstacle-present situations from obstacle-absent situations in front of the vehicle.

orrs.obligation: An admissible observable representation shall preserve whether controller failures or brake actuator failures are present, insofar as these failures are relevant to braking behavior.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: The representation must distinguish failure-present from failure-absent states for the controller and brake actuators; these states must not be merged.
